note: Campaign pictures for the public Irish cases. Each one was cut from the public ADFX paper named here, fetched from the web archive on 3 Oct 2026. Nothing comes from the private archive copies. Pictures of the UK campaigns are stills cut from public videos of the ads themselves (the page each came from is listed), chosen only where the ad is from the campaign and the years the quoted paper is about. Found and not used, because the ad is from the wrong years or could not be confirmed: Guinness, John Smith's, PG Tips, Haagen-Dazs, Stella Artois, Dave, Walkers, Marie Curie, IAG Cargo, IBM, Halifax, Vodafone Ireland, BT Northern Ireland.

note_4_oct: From 4 Oct the page shows only the pictures named in art.json beside page.tsx: one at the top and one at the top of a chapter, each from a campaign that chapter quotes. Paul, 4 Oct: "be selective... Curate" and "The artwork should be there for impact not explanation". The other files in this folder are no longer shown. Of the seven shown, one is from a private blog (Boddingtons) and Direct Line is a still from a public upload of the ad (source_kind); whether those are fine for the live page is still Paul's call.
note_4_oct_range: Paul, 4 Oct: "We also need to be rounded and have b2b and small budget and not always TV." The seven are five press, poster or outdoor (Boddingtons, IBM, The Irish Times, Lidl, Pancreatic Cancer Action) and two film stills (Guinness, Direct Line). IBM is the B2B case, Pancreatic Cancer Action the small-budget one (its paper says it had no econometric model), The Irish Times the Irish one. Honda Grrr was in chapter 7 first and is kept in fox-ads dray/output/winning-paper-art/uk1 if Paul wants it back.
